citation: Kearney v. Salomon Smith Barney, Inc., 39 Cal.4th 95 (2006)
statute_version_applicable: Cal. Penal Code §632 (post-1992; §632.7 available but §632 applied to the recorded calls at issue)
rule_established: CIPA applies extraterritorially to protect California residents; California all-party consent rule governs when a California resident is a party to the communication, even if recording occurs out of state in a one-party consent jurisdiction
verification_note: Verify 39 Cal.4th 95 citation via Westlaw or Lexis before use in filed documents
